name: master_migration_started
definition: The event is emitted anytime a blueprint (master course) migration begins.
trigger: Triggered when a MasterCourses::MasterMigration transitions into the exporting state, before content is pushed to associated (child) courses. Useful as an early signal that a blueprint sync is starting.

schema.master_migration_id: The Canvas id of the master migration.
schema.master_template_id: The Canvas id of the master template (blueprint) associated with the migration.
schema.account_id: The Canvas id of the account that owns the blueprint course.
schema.account_uuid: The uuid of the account that owns the blueprint course.
schema.blueprint_course_id: The Canvas id of the blueprint (master) course.
schema.blueprint_course_uuid: The uuid of the blueprint (master) course.
